SELECT DISTINCT sku, product_name
FROM dim_product
WHERE product_name ILIKE '%Oulu Kaakkuri%' OR product_name ILIKE '%Kaakkuri%'

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
    AND d.fiscal_week = 22
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_week, fiscal_year, MIN(calendar_date) as week_start, MAX(calendar_date) as week_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-10-05'
    AND calendar_date <= '2026-10-10'
GROUP BY fiscal_week, fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_week

SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_week, fiscal_year, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN '2026-10-04' AND '2026-10-11'

SELECT 
    SUM(f.quantity) AS gross_units_sold,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned IS NOT NULL THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) AS units_returned,
    SUM(f.quantity) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned IS NOT NULL THEN r.quantity_returned ELSE 0 END) AS net_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
    AND d.fiscal_week = 22
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE

SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
    AND d.fiscal_week = 22
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_year
